featured.excerpt: The external affairs minister's briefing covered trade, energy and Ukraine diplomacy — plus India's push to bring home citizens recruited into Russia's military.

editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: From 23-Year-Old Trailblazer to State Senate: Indian American Nabeela Syed Launches Illinois Bid
just_in.excerpt: Syed, who flipped a Republican-held Illinois House seat in 2022 as the first South Asian elected to the state legislature, is running for the 26th Senate District on a healthcare and affordability platform.
just_in.image_caption: Nabeela Syed sits on the steps of Doe Memorial Library at the University of California, Berkeley. The Indian American state representative, first elected to the Illinois House at 23, has launched her campaign for the Illinois State Senate 26th District.
just_in.nri_angle: Syed is a first-generation Indian American Muslim whose grassroots rise offers a model for young South Asian political engagement in the US.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: OpenAI Takes on Microsoft With ChatGPT's Own Office Suite at DevDay
just_in.excerpt: At DevDay in San Francisco, OpenAI unveiled Space, Pages, and collaborative slides — workplace tools that put the ChatGPT maker in direct competition with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
just_in.image_caption: A smartphone user taps the ChatGPT app icon among AI assistants including Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek, and Claude. OpenAI's new Space, Pages, and slides features move ChatGPT into workplace software territory long held by Microsoft.
just_in.nri_angle: For the large Indian diaspora workforce in American tech, the change is practical: documents and decks where distributed teams collaborate are becoming the place where AI agents operate.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Rebuts Pakistan at UN: J&K and Ladakh Are Integral, Says Envoy
just_in.excerpt: First Secretary Petal Gahlot used India's Right of Reply at the 81st UN General Assembly to reject Shehbaz Sharif's remarks on Kashmir and the Indus Waters Treaty, accusing Pakistan of cross-border terrorism.
just_in.image_caption: The UN General Assembly hall in New York, where India exercised its Right of Reply at the 81st session
just_in.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora, the UNGA exchange coincides with the 25th anniversary of September 11 — a reference Gahlot herself invoked — and follows the Pahalgam attack that killed 26 civilians in Kashmir.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Pranavi Urs Honoured at NDTV IGPL Pro-Am After Historic Asian Games Golf Gold
just_in.excerpt: Days after becoming the first Indian woman to win an individual Asian Games golf gold, the 23-year-old received a standing ovation at the NDTV IGPL Golf Pro-Am, where a ₹1 crore cash prize was announced for her.
just_in.image_caption: Pranavi Urs holds her gold medal and the Asian Games mascot at the medal ceremony in Aichi-Nagoya. She became the first Indian woman to win an individual Asian Games golf gold, finishing at 15-under 265 at the Kasugai Country Club.
just_in.nri_angle: For the diaspora, Urs' gold gives India's growing golf pipeline — from US and UK junior circuits to collegiate tours — a visible landmark in a sport where the community's presence keeps rising.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Chennai's Poppadum Turns Jain Food Into Playful Street-Food Adventure
just_in.excerpt: The Kilpauk vegetarian diner's new Jain menu runs from Indori bhutte ka kees and pav bhaji quesadillas to a Military Hotel-style potlam biriyani — all without onion, garlic or root vegetables.
just_in.image_caption: Crisp papadums — the namesake snack at Poppadum, the Chennai vegetarian diner that has launched a dedicated Jain menu
just_in.nri_angle: For the Jain diaspora and NRIs visiting Chennai, the menu shows India's dining scene is professionalising around dietary observance — eating out while keeping Jain rules no longer has to mean compromise.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: NRI Deposit Inflows Surge Seven-Fold to $36.24 Billion on RBI Swap Push
just_in.excerpt: FCNR(B) dollar deposits drew $34.53 billion — 95% of all inflows — in April-July FY27 after the RBI's concessional swap facility let banks offer NRIs dollar rates with no currency risk; total NRI deposits crossed $200 billion.
just_in.image_caption: Stacked US dollar notes. NRI deposit inflows surged nearly seven-fold to $36.24 billion during April-July FY27, driven by FCNR(B) deposits drawn in through the RBI's concessional swap facility.
just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora savings became the backbone of India's external defense, as NRIs in the Gulf and US funneled $36.24 billion into Indian banks — while steering clear of rupee-denominated accounts.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Weathered Global Turbulence With Fundamentals Intact, Sitharaman Tells Economists
just_in.excerpt: Citing 7.8% Q1 growth, 4.82% August inflation and $766 billion in forex reserves, the finance minister told the Kautilya Economic Conclave that a decade of reforms built India's shock-absorbing capacity.
just_in.image_caption: Nirmala Sitharaman, India's Union Finance Minister, speaks at an event. She said India had navigated four years of global shocks with its economic fundamentals intact and strengthening.
just_in.nri_angle: The macro picture — 7.8% growth, contained inflation, thick forex buffers — is the backdrop behind record diaspora interest in Indian equities and GIFT City instruments.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Unlikely to Face Food or Fertiliser Crisis Despite Global Headwinds, Says Panagariya
just_in.excerpt: The 16th Finance Commission chairman told ANI that strengthened fertiliser supplies and India's proven ability to absorb energy shocks mean the country need not fear the global food crisis Jaishankar warned of.
just_in.image_caption: Arvind Panagariya, chairman of the 16th Finance Commission, speaks at a press event. He told ANI that India is unlikely to face a major food or fertiliser crisis despite continuing global conflicts.
just_in.nri_angle: New Delhi is simultaneously warning of global food-crisis risk abroad and insisting India's own supplies are secure — the reassuring signal for diaspora investors and families.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: CHIME Telescope Catches 8-Billion-Year-Old Hydrogen Glow, Opening New Window on Dark Energy
just_in.excerpt: Using only its own observations, the Canadian radio telescope detected neutral hydrogen from the young universe — with Raman Research Institute scientists in the collaboration — validating a new technique to map cosmic expansion.
just_in.image_caption: The CHIME radio telescope at night near Penticton, British Columbia, with the Milky Way overhead. CHIME detected neutral hydrogen from about 8 billion light-years away, validating a new technique to study cosmic expansion.
just_in.nri_angle: Bengaluru's Raman Research Institute is part of the international collaboration behind a landmark cosmology result, underlining Indian science's place at the frontier.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Five Indian Seafarers Rescued After Projectile Strikes Kuwait-Flagged Tanker in Strait of Hormuz
just_in.excerpt: The Indian Embassy in Oman coordinated the rescue of the five crew members aboard MT Kazimah III and brought them safely ashore, amid heightened monitoring of thousands of Indian seafarers in the region.
just_in.image_caption: Smoke rises from a tanker at sea after an apparent projectile strike. The Kuwait-flagged MT Kazimah III was hit in the Strait of Hormuz; five Indian crew members were rescued and brought ashore safely.
just_in.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian seafarers work the Gulf shipping lanes — this rescue highlights both their physical risk and the consular network backing them.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Skyroot's Pawan Chandana Named to TIME100 Next 2026 After Vikram-1 Orbital Triumph
just_in.excerpt: The Skyroot Aerospace co-founder and CEO joins TIME's annual list of 100 emerging global leaders, months after his company's Vikram-1 became the first Indian private rocket to reach orbit.
just_in.image_caption: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-S rocket ahead of its Mission Prarambh suborbital flight in November 2022, which paved the way for the Vikram-1 orbital triumph
just_in.nri_angle: Pawan Chandana's TIME100 Next listing spotlights India's private space sector — built by engineers who stayed in India — as a new destination for diaspora aerospace talent and global investment.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Mandaadi Nears ₹100 Crore as Day-23 Run Keeps Soori Film on Hit Track
just_in.excerpt: Soori's Tamil sports drama collected 1.38 crore on its fourth Friday to reach 96.95 crore net in India, with the 100-crore mark expected over the fourth weekend.
just_in.image_caption: A still from Mandaadi showing Soori in a fishing-boat sequence. The Tamil sports drama reached 96.95 crore net in India after day 23, closing in on the 100-crore mark.
just_in.nri_angle: With 17.7 crore in overseas gross, the film has travelled with the Tamil diaspora in Malaysia, Singapore and the Gulf, where mid-budget sports dramas with strong word of mouth find loyal audiences.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Drishyam 3 Records 24.58 Lakh Day-One Footfalls, Bollywood's 10th-Highest Post-COVID
just_in.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's franchise finale collected 62 crore net on day one, finishing just below Tiger 3 in tickets sold while out-earning it in rupee terms.
just_in.image_caption: The official poster for Drishyam: The Conclusion, featuring Ajay Devgn as Vijay Salgaonkar. The franchise finale sold an estimated 24.58 lakh tickets on day one, the 10th-highest post-COVID day-one footfalls in Bollywood.
just_in.nri_angle: The Drishyam brand carries a devoted diaspora following — the originals spawned multi-language remakes and strong Gulf, North American and UK audiences, where day-one shows for the finale also drew packed houses.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: US FDA Puts Hyderabad Firm's Fish Masala on Salmonella Import Alert List
just_in.excerpt: Fish Masala from Tejas Food Industries LLP can now be detained at the US border without physical examination under Import Alert 99-19; the listing names no specific batch or lab result.
just_in.image_caption: A spice product illustration for the FDA import-alert story. The FDA placed Fish Masala made by Hyderabad-based Tejas Food Industries LLP on its Salmonella import-alert Red List, allowing detention of shipments at the US border without physical examination.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian-American shoppers, the alert targets one product from one Hyderabad firm at the US border — not the spice aisle at large — so checking the brand and product name on existing pantry stock is the practical takeaway.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Boiler Explosion at Andhra Pradesh Pharma Unit Kills Four, Injures Ten
news.excerpt: A boiler exploded at Till Healthcare's tablet-manufacturing plant in Sri City, Tirupati district, during the night shift, killing four workers and injuring at least ten. Rescue operations continued through the day as the state ordered a safety audit of the industrial zone.
news.image_caption: An inset view shows debris at the Sri City pharmaceutical unit where the boiler exploded, alongside Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan. Four workers were killed and at least ten injured; Pawan Kalyan ordered a comprehensive safety audit of the industrial zone.
news.nri_angle: The blast struck an Andhra Pradesh industrial corridor closely tied to diaspora families, highlighting why Indians abroad need verified casualty reporting and underscoring the role of India's private hospital network when district facilities are overwhelmed.

news.title: Putin's Nuclear Warning Over Kaliningrad Exposes the Suwalki Gap's Peril
news.excerpt: Putin said a direct attack on Kaliningrad would put Moscow's full arsenal on the agenda "inevitably and immediately" — a warning that spotlights the Suwalki Gap, NATO's exposed 65-km land link to the Baltic states, and the Baltic shipping lanes India depends on for Russian oil.
news.image_caption: A briefing screen shows a map of Kaliningrad, Russia's Baltic exclave, wedged between Poland and Lithuania, flanked by NATO, EU, Polish, and Lithuanian flags. On October 1, 2026, President Vladimir Putin warned that a direct attack on the exclave would put Moscow's full arsenal on the agenda "inevitably and immediately."
news.nri_angle: Indian students study in Kaliningrad, and Indian refiners depend on Baltic Sea lanes for seaborne Russian crude, so escalation in the exclave would hit Indian families and fuel prices directly.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Guwahati Nightclub Horror: Video Shows Woman Stripped, Assaulted By Bouncers
news.excerpt: A viral video shows a woman being stripped and beaten by bouncers at 'The Locals' disco club in Guwahati's Khanapara area; accounts of what triggered the violence conflict, and Guwahati Police have registered a case and opened an investigation.
news.image_caption: A blurred still from the viral video shows several men standing around a person on the floor of a basement in a Guwahati building. The video, which surfaced after a Thursday night incident at 'The Locals' disco club in Khanapara, allegedly shows bouncers stripping and beating a woman; Guwahati Police have registered a case and opened an investigation.
news.nri_angle: For diaspora women visiting Guwahati or with family there, the case is a stark reminder that nightlife safety in parts of India remains precarious — private club security staff can themselves become the source of danger.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: 17-Year-Old Held in Lucknow After Mother Killed in Family Dispute
news.excerpt: Police say a 17-year-old boy in Lucknow fatally attacked his 42-year-old mother with an iron wrench during an argument, then called his father and the police himself. The teenager is in custody and being questioned.
news.image_caption: A forensic investigator in protective gear examines a crime scene marked with police tape. Lucknow police said a forensic team examined the family residence after the teenager reported the killing.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Manchester City Verdict Strains Britain's Diplomatic Ties With the UAE
news.excerpt: The UAE has warned London that sanctions against the Abu Dhabi-owned club could cool future investment, while British ministers privately question whether senior Emirati figures knew of the £900 million financial misconduct.
news.image_caption: Manchester City's Etihad Stadium in Manchester, with its distinctive cable-stayed roof masts visible. The Abu Dhabi-owned club was found guilty of 130 breaches of Premier League financial rules, a verdict now straining diplomatic ties between the UK and the UAE.
news.nri_angle: The UAE hosts one of the largest Indian communities in the world, and friction over London-Abu Dhabi investment flows matters to the diaspora in both countries.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Bangkok Struggles With Worst Flooding in 15 Years as Water Recedes
news.excerpt: Some 320 mm of rain in two to three days left waist-deep water across the capital, killed at least eight nationwide, stranded Thai Airways passengers, and could shave 0.3 points off GDP growth.
news.image_caption: Floodwaters recede in Bangkok after the city's worst flooding in 15 years.
news.nri_angle: Bangkok is a major destination for Indian travellers; New Delhi flights were cancelled and baggage chaos at Suvarnabhumi hit Indian passengers hardest, while Bangkok's Indian trading community sits in the wholesale districts expected to take the heaviest economic hit.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: NASA Chief Warns China Could Shut U.S. Out of Lunar South Pole
news.excerpt: Administrator Jared Isaacman said China's delayed Chang'e 7 mission targeted the same Shackleton Crater the U.S. wants, and safety exclusion zones could lock American missions out of the water-ice-rich terrain.
news.image_caption: NASA's chief warns China could shut the U.S. out of the lunar south pole.
news.nri_angle: India is an Artemis Accords signatory and Indian media reported NASA invited ISRO into the moon base program, placing India's space agency among the partners defining lunar norms.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: From Security Guard to Rs 50 Lakh a Month: Assam Man's Frozen Paratha Triumph
news.excerpt: Diganta Das of Gohpur, Assam, went from earning Rs 1,200 a month as a construction labourer to running a frozen Malabar parotta brand that produces over 20,000 parottas a day.
news.image_caption: Diganta Das’s DFF brand produces more than 20,000 frozen Malabar parottas a day.
news.nri_angle: Das's rise from migrant worker to food entrepreneur mirrors the journey of many diaspora families who built businesses from a single trade, and his frozen Malabar parottas sit in one of the fastest-growing diaspora grocery segments.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Nearly 1.9 Lakh Cancer Cases in India Tied to Infections, Lancet Study Finds
news.excerpt: A Lancet study estimates infections caused nearly 1.9 lakh of India's new cancer cases in 2024, led by HPV-linked cervical cancer, highlighting the role of vaccination and screening in prevention.
news.image_caption: Researchers study infection-linked cancers in a laboratory
news.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the study is a reminder that cancer-prevention norms differ by geography: many countries offer HPV vaccination to adolescents and routine HPV screening to adult women as standard care, and NRIs traveling with or caring for family in India can help close the gap by encouraging both.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Putin Says PM Modi Has 'Very Good Ideas' for Ending Ukraine Conflict
news.excerpt: The Russian president, speaking at the Valdai International Discussion Club, said Modi raises the issue of ending the war at every meeting and that Moscow is thankful for India's push for a peaceful settlement.
news.image_caption: Russian President Vladimir Putin shakes hands with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, both smiling, at a recent meeting. Putin praised Modi's "very good ideas" for a mutually acceptable settlement of the Ukraine conflict at the Valdai International Discussion Club on October 1.
news.nri_angle: The diaspora has watched India's balancing act since 2022 — from student evacuations in Ukraine to energy-price ripples — and Putin's public praise will be read as validation of India's growing diplomatic weight.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Journalist Among Eight Palestinians Killed in Israeli Attacks on Gaza
news.excerpt: Palestinian journalist Muhammad Abdel Aziz al-Najjar, the 263rd media worker killed since October 2023, died as Israeli strikes hit a Gaza City van, an apartment, and a displaced-persons shelter amid continued ceasefire violations.
news.image_caption: A dusty street in Deir el-Balah in the Gaza Strip after Israeli bombing, August 2024. A journalist was among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza.
news.nri_angle: India's large media community and diaspora follow Gaza's journalist death toll closely; Indian press-freedom advocates have demanded international accountability for the killing of media workers.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.excerpt: The Shree Swaminarayan Vadtal Dham Hindu Mandir in Richmond Heights was struck around 1:30 pm on Friday while priests and devotees were inside. No arrests have been reported, and surveillance footage is under review.
nri-world.image_caption: Shattered glass lies scattered across the floor inside the Shree Swaminarayan Vadtal Dham Hindu Mandir after the attack. The Richmond Heights, Ohio temple was struck with bricks on Friday afternoon while priests and devotees were inside.
nri-world.nri_angle: The attack targeted a place of worship for Hindu Americans in Ohio during prayers, sharpening community fears about temple safety and the response to anti-Hindu hate in the US.
